---
title: "check-source-overlap.yml"
---

Flag paragraphs of Markdown and Quarto prose that copy a reference text, as a
guard against unintentional plagiarism by authors and AI agents alike.

## Why this check

A language model that has read a textbook can reproduce its sentences without
anyone noticing, and a bulk-generated chapter can carry passages no author
reviewed for provenance.
Crediting the source does not cure a copied passage, so this check looks for
the copying itself.

## What it does

It reads the PDFs (or `.txt` files) named by `corpus-files` from a private
corpus repository, extracts their text with `pdftotext` into the runner's
temporary directory, and compares each paragraph the pull request adds with
that text by word 6-grams.
A paragraph is flagged when at least `min-run` consecutive words occur verbatim
in a source, or when a quarter or more of its 6-grams do.
The extracted text is never uploaded or committed.

Not compared, by design: fenced code, math, table rows, citations, URLs,
Quarto attributes, blockquotes, and text in quotation marks.
A paragraph containing `<!-- overlap-ok: reason -->` is skipped, for a passage
checked by hand.

**It finds copying that the corpus holds.**
A source nobody put in the corpus is invisible, and a paraphrase that keeps no
run of six consecutive words is missed.
It is a net, not a proof of originality.

**A run that could not check anything exits 2, not 0.**
An empty or missing corpus, or no input files, is an error.
A change that adds no prose passes, and the summary line reports
`examined 0 paragraphs`.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `corpus-repo` | string | `'Morrison-Lab/mlr'` | Repository holding the reference PDFs, as `owner/name`. |
| `corpus-files` | string | required | Comma- or newline-separated git pathspecs of the PDFs or `.txt` files in `corpus-repo`. |
| `base-ref` | string | `''` | Git base ref; only lines added since it are checked. Use `HEAD^1` on a pull request. Empty checks every Markdown and Quarto file in `paths`. |
| `paths` | string | `''` | Space-separated files to check when `base-ref` is empty. |
| `paths-ignore` | string | `':(exclude)_extensions :(exclude)lectures'` | Space-separated git pathspecs to exclude, in both modes. |
| `min-run` | string | `'12'` | Consecutive verbatim words that flag a paragraph. |
| `fail` | boolean | `false` | Fail the job when a paragraph is flagged (else warn only). |

## Secrets

| Secret | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `corpus-token` | yes | A token that can read `corpus-repo`; the workflow token reaches only the caller's repository. |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read`.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check source overlap
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['**.qmd', '**.md']
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-source-overlap.yml@v3
    with:
      corpus-files: 'books/Hastie-*.pdf'
      base-ref: HEAD^1
    #   fail: true
    secrets:
      corpus-token: ${{ secrets.CORPUS_TOKEN }}
```

See `check-source-overlap.yml` in
[`examples/`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/tree/main/examples)
for the full caller stub.
An agent can run the same script before pushing:
`python3 check-source-overlap/check_source_overlap.py --corpus <dir of .txt>
--git-diff origin/main`.
